source_user: Advanced cluster case multi-node NCCL-100: A multi-node NCCL job hangs only at larger world sizes. Produce a falsifiable diagnosis and rollback plan. Variant 100 must state assumptions, define a falsifiable hypothesis, name metrics, and include one failure or rollback condition.
source_assistant: An expert answer should distinguish model-domain mechanisms from runtime measurements. Required technical anchors: test rank mapping, interface selection, topology, NIC affinity, rendezvous, firewall and ports, timeout logs, communicator formation, reduced-world baselines, and network counters. It must report topology, workload, units, baselines, confounders, and evidence needed before claiming improvement.
corrected_answer:
Treat the hang as an observation, not proof of cause. Assumptions: the collective and message shapes, failing world sizes, placement, launcher, and software stack can be reproduced; unknown platform facts must be measured. Record exact NCCL/CUDA/driver/framework/container/launcher versions, node and GPU inventory, rank-to-device mapping/order, parallelism placement, topology, selected interface and NIC/NUMA affinity, MTU/routes, InfiniBand/RoCE mode, rendezvous endpoint, authorized firewall/port policy, timeout settings, and clock synchronization. Redact endpoints, tokens, and credentials.

Falsifiable hypothesis for variant 100: rank-to-device or collective ordering diverges when the added ranks participate. Hold workload, versions, placement, message sizes, and timeout policy constant. Binary-search the minimum failing world size and repeat each condition at least three times. Compare a known-good reduced-world run, the first failing world size, and a matched full-world run; change one suspected factor at a time. Collect synchronized per-rank logs containing the last completed communicator phase/collective, rank mapping, selected transport, first-failure timestamp, timeout reason, and communicator-formation result. Capture topology and route/NIC selections, rendezvous and authorized-port reachability, and timestamped NIC/fabric counters such as bytes/s, packets/s, drops, retries, link errors, RTT, and retransmits; report units, sampling interval, percentile/median, and baseline. Also record GPU/host utilization, memory, temperatures, process exits, file descriptors, and resource limits where relevant.

Interpretation: the hypothesis is supported only if the predicted failure boundary and rank/path signature reproduce and the matched intervention removes the hang without degrading throughput, error rate, or correctness. A passing smaller job is not proof that the larger job is healthy, and a correlated counter is not causal evidence. Check confounders including placement changes, traffic load, clock skew, process cleanup, retries, and stale rendezvous state.

Safety and rollback: use read-only diagnostics first and make only authorized, logged, reversible changes. Do not broaden firewall exposure or disable authentication. Canary one isolated allocation; stop and restore the prior configuration if any rank loses contact, a collective error appears, correctness checks fail, p95 step time worsens by more than 10% from the matched baseline, link errors/drops rise, or the run exceeds the agreed timeout. Kill the canary cleanly, remove temporary rendezvous state, restore environment variables/routes/affinity, and verify a known-good reduced-world test before resuming. Claim resolution only after repeated matched runs and archived redacted evidence. If the proposed hypothesis is not supported, keep the change rolled back and continue with the next evidence-based hypothesis.

Compare a known-good reduced-world run, the first failing world size, and a matched full-world run; change one suspected factor at a time. Collect synchronized per-rank logs containing the last completed communicator phase/collective, rank mapping, selected transport, first-failure timestamp, timeout reason, and communicator-formation result. Interpretation: the hypothesis is supported only if the predicted failure boundary and rank/path signature reproduce and the matched intervention removes the hang without degrading throughput, error rate, or correctness. A passing smaller job is not proof that the larger job is healthy, and a correlated counter is not causal evidence. Check confounders including placement changes, traffic load, clock skew, process cleanup, retries, and stale rendezvous state.

Safety and rollback: use read-only diagnostics first and make only authorized, logged, reversible changes. Do not broaden firewall exposure or disable authentication. Canary one isolated allocation; stop and restore the prior configuration if any rank loses contact, a collective error appears, correctness checks fail, p95 step time worsens by more than 10% from the matched baseline, link errors/drops rise, or the run exceeds the agreed timeout. Kill the canary cleanly, remove temporary rendezvous state, restore environment variables/routes/affinity, and verify a known-good reduced-world test before resuming. Claim resolution only after repeated matched runs and archived redacted evidence. If the proposed hypothesis is not supported, keep the change rolled back and continue with the next evidence-based hypothesis.
